books.title: The Roundabout
books.subtitle: A novella in seven laps
books.author: Luca Gandolfi
books.blurb: An eighty-three-year-old man keeps circling a roundabout in his old Panda, a parcel from a dead woman unopened in the trunk. A quiet novella about first love, a long marriage, and the exits we are afraid to take.
